_about.what: The remake's own glitch tricks (Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time, versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.1), each an OoTR trick (off by default) that tools/rando/parity/glitches.py applies. (python tools/rando/glitch_report.py checklist).
_about.default: Every trick is off. generate.register_remake_tricks registers each name with OoTR's allowed_tricks, so a settings file can turn it on (or "logic_remake_glitch_...": true, as the app's Detailed Logic > Remake glitches switches write it). Logic Rules 'Glitched (remake glitches)' (logic_rules remake_glitched) turns on every trick with routes in logic (parity/glitches.py resolve_settings).
_about.rules: Live routes: a source shows the route (high confidence). Each: id, region (an OoTR region, or a 'Remake ...' region glitches.py makes), kind (exit | location | event | helper), target (exit destination, location or event name, or a helper name), add (the route, ORed beside the normal rule; for a helper, beside every use of it), confidence, test (what to try in the game), note, source. Optional: new (the exit/event doesn't exist in OoTR: made closed, the route opens it), optional (the spot is another plugin's, e.g. a drop-group event: skipped when that plugin is off).
_about.candidates: Routes to test in the game (medium or low confidence): same fields. None is in any seed's logic until marked "verified": "YYYY-MM-DD" (then live); "refuted": why (never live), "blocked": why logic can't express it (never live).
_about.helpers: data/rando/logic/glitches.json: remake_ijsc (Deku Sticks as child, Megaton Hammer as adult, plus another quick-menu item: remake_quick_menu_item), remake_ijsc_child, remake_ijsc_adult, remake_actor_jump_adult.
_about.confidence: high: the runner's own written method or tutorial (ZSR's oot2026 pages count) plus independent confirmation, or an any% route step; medium: one primary source with a method, or the technique proven and the spot plausible; low: a title, a chapter heading or a single news claim.
_about.versions: Every trick here works on 1.1.1 as well as 1.0.0. Hookshot Storage (1.0 only) is in the research notes, not in any trick.

logic_remake_glitch_jsc.name: Infinite Jump Slash Cancel (infinite height)
logic_remake_glitch_jsc.description: Jump-attack with the Deku Stick (child) or Megaton Hammer (adult), open the quick item menu mid-attack, swap to another item and back, and buffer a new jump attack: each cycle stops the fall and adds height; holding Target keeps Link moving forward. Live routes: the Graveyard Shadow Temple ledge (both ages), the Shadow Temple as a child (entrance pit, gaps, high silver crystals), the Kakariko gate and King Zora as a child, the Gerudo Valley bridge, the Gerudo Card skip, the Mirror Shield hand, Dodongo's Cavern's early Bomb Bag, the adult Deku Tree and the Fire Trial door. About 80 more height and gap routes are on the in-game checklist.
logic_remake_glitch_jsc.found_by: Ataappi (credited by Kethaldo, Linkus7, Chris Crikeyson); tutorial gymnast86; ZSR technique page (Vespher)
logic_remake_glitch_jsc.difficulty: hard (1-3 frame menu timing); in every any% run since 2026-11-08
logic_remake_glitch_jsc.ootr_analog: can_hover (glitch_hovering, N64 bomb hover with ISG), which does not work in the remake

logic_remake_glitch_kz_stick_lift.requires: Child; Deku Sticks and another quick-menu item.

logic_remake_glitch_dc_skip.name: Dodongo's Cavern early Bomb Bag (jump slash cancel)
logic_remake_glitch_dc_skip.description: Child IJSC from the cavern's lobby, or from the lava pool by the spiked wall, straight up to the Bomb Bag chest; the any% route takes the bombs and leaves.

rules.note: Child IJSC from the lobby, or from the lava pool by the spiked wall, up to the Bomb Bag chest (ZSR Dodongo's Cavern page; an any% route step: 'Early Bomb Bag', then leave). Far Bridge holds the Bomb Bag chest; Far Bridge -> Mouth still needs explosives.

logic_remake_glitch_dc_skip.requires: Child; Deku Sticks and another quick-menu item (adult with the Hammer is a candidate).
logic_remake_glitch_dc_skip.achieves: Dodongos Cavern Far Bridge (Bomb Bag chest) from the lobby.

logic_remake_glitch_hc_talon_skip.name: Hyrule Castle garden without waking Talon (refuted: Zelda won't talk)
logic_remake_glitch_hc_talon_skip.description: A child can jump slash cancel over the castle hedges into Zelda's courtyard without the Weird Egg, but Zelda won't talk until Talon is woken (ZSR Progression Triggers), so her checks stay locked and the route opens nothing.

candidates.refuted: 2026-11-20 (source, not an in-game test): ZSR Progression Triggers: a child reaches the courtyard over the hedges, but Zelda won't talk until Talon is woken, so Zelda's Letter and Zelda's Lullaby stay locked; OoTR's HC Garden would give both.

logic_remake_glitch_forest_temple_ledge.name: Forest Temple entrance without the Hookshot, adult (untested: no route in logic yet)
logic_remake_glitch_forest_temple_ledge.description: IJSC up to the Forest Temple entrance ledge in Sacred Forest Meadow as an adult without the Hookshot. Shown by ThreeLetterName (items not narrated). A child can't: the child map has push-off walls on the ledge.
logic_remake_glitch_forest_temple_ledge.items: Megaton Hammer and another quick-menu item

candidates.note: Inside, the remake's Forest Temple Lobby -> Central Area needs a small key, and the First Room Chest the Hookshot.
candidates.test: Adult with the Megaton Hammer (no Hookshot): IJSC up to the Forest Temple entrance ledge. ThreeLetterName got in as adult without the Hookshot (items not narrated; he had Hover Boots). As a child it can't work: the child map has two push-off walls on the ledge (game data; shown).

candidates.refuted: 2026-11-20 (source): the child map has two push-off air walls on the ledge (sloperina's game-data notes); ThreeLetterName: no way in with Young Link.

logic_remake_glitch_gs_dupe.name: Gold Skulltula token duplication (save/reload) (untested: no route in logic yet)
logic_remake_glitch_gs_dupe.description: Save by hand next to a Gold Skulltula, kill it with the Boomerang, backflip onto the exit before the token comes back (the level change autosaves), reload the latest autosave; repeat. The guides use the Hyrule Castle Song of Storms grotto's Skulltula. Only with vanilla tokens there: with shuffled tokens it would repeat whatever item the spot holds. Candidate routes: the Skulltula House rewards.
logic_remake_glitch_gs_dupe.found_by: NoHypothesis (2026-11-12); guides by Jay Dunna, AbdallahSmash, Game is Lifer
logic_remake_glitch_gs_dupe.items: Boomerang (one guide also uses Song of Storms for a grotto)
